text:
claire: quick design review: i'm proposing we tighten the toolbar action spacing across the dashboard and surface a compact variant for dense tables. want signoff before i land the tokens.

ben: curious what "tighten" means numerically. are we changing outer padding or inter-action gap?

claire: proposal: global adoption of `--space-2` (8px) for horizontal gaps inside action groups, keep `--space-3` (12px) for card/container padding. that makes toolbars feel more compact without changing overall layout rhythm.

rachel: +1 for consistency. one flag: table header actions already feel cramped on 1024px width. if we reduce gap, we should cap label truncation and ensure 44px min touch.

claire: agreed. plan: `.toolbar-action { gap: var(--space-2); min-height:44px; padding: 0 var(--space-2); }` and add `.toolbar-action--compact` for icon-only or very short labels.

tom: accessibility: ensure focus ring doesn't overlap adjacent controls once compressed. use `outline-offset:4px` and `--color-focus-strong` for contrast. also test keyboard flow when actions wrap to a second line.

priya: note from last sprint: we saw focus jumping when visual order used CSS `order`. keep DOM order stable; use visual offsets only via transforms if needed. add test: keyboard tab through wrapped toolbar actions on mobile.

ben: small copy thing: in compact toolbars we often switch verbs to shorter forms (e.g., "Export" vs "Start export"). prefer consistent sentence case across toolbars.

claire: i'll normalize labels to sentence case and keep full verbs on primary actions.

rachel: toasts: on the narrow right rail we've had collisions with floating toolbars. suggestion: move toasts to top-center for dashboards, top-right for multi-column views, and switch to bottom-center for mobile. newest toast should appear on top of the stack.

priya: I recommend newest-on-top for discoverability; screen readers will only announce the most recent with `aria-live="polite"`. errors should use `role="alert"` and be persistent. info toasts auto-dismiss at 5s, warnings 10s.

claire: implement container offsets with `--toast-offset-x: var(--space-4)` so they never overlap the right rail CTAs. also set `pointer-events:none` on the container and `pointer-events:auto` on the toast itself to prevent accidental clicks through.

ben: what about stacking behavior? do we compact gap between toasts?

rachel: use `--toast-gap: var(--space-2)` and max visible 3 to avoid long stacks. animate entrance from the top with translateY to avoid layout shift.

tom: modal close affordance: since we're shrinking toolbar density we should ensure modals with action rows don't hide the close X behind condensed elements. propose a persistent 16px margin for modal header buttons using `--space-3`.

priya: agree. also ensure the close button is last in DOM for modal header with `aria-label="Close dialog"` and visible focus on keyboard.

claire: added a small a11y checklist to the PR: focus ring contrast, DOM order preserved, keyboard wrap tests, toast aria rules, Esc dismiss + focus restoration to triggering element.

ben: tiny copy nit for toasts: use "Dismiss" for action buttons, not "Close" or "Got it". keeps it consistent with other controls.

rachel: add a test for screen reader announcement when two toasts appear within 500ms; ensure only the newest is spoken.

ux-bot: preview deployed at https://deploy-preview.redwood/design/toolbar-compact-1805554321  includes visual diffs and token changes.

claire: thanks all 64f i'll open the token PR (`--space-2` adoption for action gaps) and include visual examples: toolbar, dense table header, modal action row, and mobile wrap. if a11y passes, we'll freeze for the sprint.
